product.title: Day Trip from Boston To Salem Witch Exhibits

description.text: Visit Salem's witch museums and waterfront on a small-group day trip from Boston with hotel pickup and museum admissions included. Tour the Salem Witch Museum, House of the Seven Gables, and Pickering Wharf with a Salem trolley segment and free time on Essex Street Pedestrian Mall. The eight- to nine-hour premium format includes bottled water and structured time at each exhibit so you see Salem's trial history without planning logistics. Suited to travelers who want a guided Salem immersion with door-to-door transport from Boston.

highlights: Small-group Salem day trip from Boston with hotel pickup
House of the Seven Gables visit
Salem trolley and Pickering Wharf free time
